items.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: it’s a couple of extra horns on some of the tracks. Dan Barrett’s on it

ctx.x: Yeah that’s already been recorded. That’s coming out next week I think. It’s a rhythm section, it’s a couple of extra horns on some of the tracks. Dan Barrett’s on it, my brother David plays cornet and trumpet on maybe half of it. And the contrabass is on two cuts and the rest, there’s a lot of bass sax, there’s some sarrousaphone and tenor, C melody and so on. I didn’t play any brass on this record.
But you do play brass too.
